info.name: RentCheck REST Account Settings Automations API
List automations for the caller's subscription

params.name: options[sort][sort_type]
params.description:
Sort direction. The value is uppercased before use, so both upper-
and lower-case forms are accepted.

items.docs:
Returns automations belonging to the caller's active subscription, with
pagination and sorting controlled via `options[pagination]` /
`options[sort]` query parameters. Defaults are
`page_size=20`, `page_number=0`, `sort_by=created_at`,
`sort_type=DESC`. Allowed `sort_by` values are listed below.

Creates a new automation for the caller's active subscription. New
automations are created in the deactivated state (`active: false`) and
must be enabled via a follow-up `PUT` call.

The following cross-field validation rules apply:
  * `selection_type.ids` is required when `selection_type.type` is
    `specific_units` or `specific_teams`.
  * `assignment_type.emails` is required when `assignment_type.type` is
    `emails`; `assignment_type.teammate_emails` is required when type is
    `teammate

Returns the requested automation. The automation must exist and belong
to the caller's active subscription; otherwise `automation not found` is
returned.

Patch an existing automation. All body fields are optional; if
`recurrence` is supplied, `trigger_type` must be supplied as well.

Side-effects worth noting:
  * If the resolved template has `is_fast_track_enabled: false`,
    `fast_track` is forced to `false` on the stored automation
    regardless of what the request body says.
  * If the resulting `trigger_type` is `tenant-move-out` or `lease-end`,
    `recurrence` is reset to `does_not_repeat` (with all
    custom fields cleared).

Hard-removes the automation. RC default automations
(`is_rc_automation: true`) cannot be removed, and the caller must hold
the `canEditAutomation` permission **and** the subscription must have
the inspection automation addon. Returns 204 on success.
